desc: Pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed copies of newspaper publication published in newspaper in Free Press (English) and in Navshakti Times (vernacular - Marathi) dated September 08, 2026, in connection with dispatch of notice of 39th Annual General Meeting to be held on Wednesday, September 30, 2026 at 12.00 noon through Video Conferencing (VC) / Other Audio Visual Means (OAVM).
